stem.text: Which compound can be oxidised by acidified potassium manganate(VII) to give 3-methylpentan-2-one?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a tertiary alcohol: a carbon bearing OH, two methyl groups and a propyl chain.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a tertiary alcohol: a carbon bearing OH, one methyl group and two ethyl groups.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: CH3C(=O)CH(CH3)CH2CH2OH, a ketone with a methyl branch and a terminal OH group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: CH3CH(OH)CH(CH3)CH2CH3, a secondary alcohol with a methyl branch on the adjacent carbon.
